name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.ShallowSplit.large_class_rigid
title: Colorings with the same large monochromatic sets have the same large classes
statement: If for every finset T with N <= |T|, T is kappa-monochromatic iff kappa'-monochromatic, then every kappa-class of size >= N equals the kappa'-class of the same point.
